name: Samarkand – Crossroad of Cultures
description: Samarkand, in southeastern Uzbekistan, is one of Central Asia's oldest cities, settled around the 7th century BC and later a key stop on the Silk Road. Its great age of building came under Timur and his heirs, who raised the Registan's grand madrasas, the Gur-Emir mausoleum and the Shah-i-Zinda necropolis, all glowing with cobalt and turquoise tilework.
